page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Ax.Flex.2-8 is an x86_64 virtual server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 physical cores and 4 dedicated vCPUs operating with 2 threads per core. System memory is sized at 8.0 GB total, yielding an allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, matching a 1:2 compute-optimized resource distribution.

Hardware acceleration and integrated non-volatile storage are omitted from this configuration; the instance provides no GPUs and no local storage. Persistent storage and operating system volumes rely entirely on attached remote block storage solutions. The instance includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address for public networking access.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio offers a cost-effective operational profile for compute-oriented tasks that do not need large working memory footprints. Because local NVMe disks are not bundled, storage requirements must factor in network storage latency. This instance configuration suits workloads such as light CI/CD workers, web servers, build pipelines, batch compute tasks, and microservices requiring dedicated x86 CPU cores.
